title: Partial refunds short by one paisa on amounts like 1155.10
body: Refunds for charges such as 1155.10 come out as 115509 minor units instead of 115510. Customers are refunded one paisa short and finance reconciliation for incident INC-4471 flags them. CI job `test-refunds` fails on main. Affected rows are in payments.refunds where status = 'short'.
